title: Drunk Woman Ruins Her Friends Birthday Party After Causing Chaos
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On December 3rd, 2023. Officers were called to a residence in regards to a highly intoxicated woman who was acting in an irrational manner after refusing to leave her friends birthday party. She was so drunk she picked up an item and smashed her friends window after being locked out of the house. When officers arrived she was very uncooperative and kept ranting about a lot of things that did not make sense. She caused approximately $800 in damages to her friends house.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
